subject.title: Feature request: fallback model chain for compaction and LCM summaryModel

question: Should OpenClaw add a public fallback-chain contract for compaction, and should Lossless `summaryModel` fallback be part of the same core change or owned separately by the context-engine plugin?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the fix adds configuration and provider/auth routing semantics while crossing the core compaction and external Lossless context-engine boundary.

options.title: Split core and Lossless ownership
options.body: Add a narrowly scoped `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` contract for embedded compaction and track Lossless `summaryModel` fallback as plugin-owned or SDK-bound follow-up work.

options.title: Approve one shared design
options.body: Design a shared runtime/plugin fallback API that covers embedded compaction and Lossless summary models together before any implementation PR.

options.title: Decline the new surface
options.body: Keep exact compaction model behavior and require operators to use existing chat fallbacks, plugin behavior, or external routing instead of adding config.

recommendation.title: Split core and Lossless ownership
recommendation.body: Add a narrowly scoped `agents.defaults.compaction.fallbacks` contract for embedded compaction and track Lossless `summaryModel` fallback as plugin-owned or SDK-bound follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about model fallback/config semantics, and this history includes shared model fallback refactor ownership.
